plainTranslation:
The energy between you is immediate and strong.

This person activates something in you, your drive, your desire, your will, and the charge can be hard to ignore. There is often a powerful physical attraction here, a magnetism that makes this person feel compelling in a way that overrides your usual caution. You may feel more alive, more driven, more switched on around them.

When this works, you are a force together. You can spur each other to act, pursue what you want with real intensity, and accomplish things through the sheer power of your combined drive. The attraction can be deep and the loyalty fierce. Pointed at a shared goal, this energy builds rather than burns.

The harder part is that the same intensity can turn destructive. You may provoke each other in ways that escalate beyond what either of you intended, where a small disagreement becomes something neither of you can stop, and the heat that pulled you together starts to feel frightening instead of exciting. The drive to be close can become a need to control. Wanting can curdle into possessiveness, jealousy, the sense of being watched or owned. The connection can lock into a cycle where things break down hard and then pull back together harder, and each time it gets a little more difficult to leave.

Aim the energy at something outside the two of you, and be honest about what it brings out in you. This works when the intensity builds something. When it starts to scare you, when the fights leave damage, when you find yourself managing this person's reactions or your own just to keep the peace, that is not a phase to push through. Intensity is never a reason to stay somewhere that is hurting you.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
